UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Authenticated user profile and immutable role assignment (teacher or student) for Smart Classroom.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the user.

displayName.description: Full display name of the teacher or student (2 to 80 characters).

role.description: Immutable user role selected during registration.

emailVerified.description: Whether the user's email is verified in Firebase Auth.

institution.description: Optional department, school, or grade level.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the profile was created (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the profile was last updated (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

/users/{userId}.description: Stores private user profile, email, and role metadata keyed by Firebase Auth UID.
